lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits, with primary maxima arranged in approximate horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance upper edge and a lower-luminance shadow area, indicating structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a high density of small, high-luminance blobs distributed uniformly across its visible surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vermiculated (labyrinthine) high-luminance line patterns are visible on the upper flank between the gill slits and the start of the regular spot grid.
